mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 4.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in consumer demand, triggering reduced corporate revenue expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two consecutive months, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 for two consecutive months signals manufacturing supply chain disruption, compressing corporate margins and increasing inflationary pressures, which causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 4.5% for three consecutive months signals persistent inflation, prompting delayed Federal Reserve rate cuts and increasing real interest rates, which depresses equity valuations and generates negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC over 2 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls above its 12-month moving average indicates strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real retail sales below its 6-month moving average for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 6-month moving average for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where RSAFS is below its 6-month moving average for two consecutive months, or Rank IC over 4 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production above its 12-month moving average indicates expanding manufacturing output, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 2 years falls below 0.03.
